convention: tay_trai/tay_phai, chan_trai/chan_phai theo phia nhan vat (nhan vat nhin ra man hinh). z: so thap = ve sau (sau), so cao = ve truoc. pivot: [x,y] theo toa do canvas goc.

parts.name: phu_kien_hieu_ung
parts.note: Khoi tim + bong do duoi chan (hieu ung nen). z thap nhat. Animation: khoi bay luon lap (uv scroll/alpha pulse); bong co dinh theo chan.

parts.name: chan_trai
parts.note: Chan trai NV (phai anh), giay den. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: chan_phai
parts.note: Chan phai NV (trai anh), giay den. Pivot hong. Di lai: xoay quanh hong.

parts.name: than
parts.note: Ao den vien do. Pivot giua nguc. Cui chao: xoay nhe.

parts.name: tay_trai
parts.note: Tay trai NV (phai anh) buong. Pivot vai. Vay tay: xoay quanh vai.

parts.name: tay_phai
parts.note: Tay phai NV (trai anh) chong hong. Pivot vai.

parts.name: dau
parts.note: Mu trum + mat na quy. Pivot co. Gat/lac dau: xoay quanh co.

parts.name: phu_kien_sung
parts.note: Cap sung vang + dau lau tren mu. Pivot goc sung. Nghieng theo dau.
